title: Creator Vanity Public Project Links
summary: Link each already-authorized explicit-public project presentation on a creator vanity page to its anonymous public project detail page.
linkContract: Only projects already returned by the anonymous explicit-public creator project collection are linkable.
The href is derived only from the already-public project.id route identifier.
The visible link text remains project.title.
Optional project.description remains presentation text outside the route identifier.
No additional persistence read is introduced by link construction.
No private project is linked or probed.
preservedBoundaries: Canonical creator handle agreement remains required.
Collection inconsistency or unavailable state remains 503.
No identity database or authenticated session is introduced.
No SESH_AUDIO or R2 access is introduced.
Public presentation grants no copyright, master, composition, publishing, distribution, management, label, royalty, licensing, revenue, collaborator, legal, or account rights.
scope: No migration is authored or executed.
